disclaimer: If you are in immediate danger or risk of harming yourself or others, please call 911 or your local emergency number immediately.
emergencyMessage: You matter. Help is available. Please reach out — you don't have to face this alone.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Free and confidential support for people in distress, and prevention and crisis resources. Call or text 988.

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.description: Free, 24/7 crisis support via text message. Connect with a trained Crisis Counselor.

resources.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.description: Free, confidential treatment referral and information service for mental health and substance use disorders.

resources.name: The Trevor Project (LGBTQ+ Youth)
resources.description: Crisis intervention and suicide prevention for LGBTQ+ young people. Text START to 678-678.

resources.name: Veterans Crisis Line
resources.description: Confidential crisis support for veterans and their families. Also text 838255.

resources.name: Samaritans (UK & Ireland)
resources.description: Free, confidential emotional support for people experiencing feelings of distress or despair.

resources.name: Beyond Blue (Australia)
resources.description: Support for anxiety, depression, and suicide prevention.

resources.name: Crisis Services Canada
resources.description: Canada Suicide Prevention Service — available 24 hours a day.

resources.name: iCall (India)
resources.description: Psychosocial helpline by TISS providing free counseling and support.

warningSignsToWatch: Talking about wanting to die or to kill oneself
Looking for ways to kill oneself
Talking about being a burden to others
Increasing use of alcohol or drugs
Withdrawing from friends, family, and activities
Talking about feeling hopeless or having no reason to live
Talking about feeling trapped or in unbearable pain
Saying goodbye to people as if they won't be seen again
ifSomeoneIsInCrisis: Stay with them — don't leave them alone
Remove access to any lethal means if safe to do so
Ask directly: 'Are you thinking about suicide?' — asking does not plant the idea
Encourage them to call a crisis line or take them to the nearest emergency room
Call 911 if there is immediate danger
